text: Alaa ɓurɗo tooñude wa on fefindiiɗo fenaande baki e Alla, maa o fenni Aayeeje Makko ɗen. Ɓen siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji, ɓe heɓay geɓal maɓɓe ngal aduna ngal ɓe winndanaa ka Alluwal reenaangal ; haa si Malaa'ikaajo waroowo on arii ɓe fii ƴettitugol pittaali maɓɓe ɗin, ɓe felira ɓe wi'angol ɓe : "Ko honto ɗin ɗi rewaynoɗon gaanin Alla woni?!" Noddee ɗi fii ko faaboo on. Sirkooɓe ɓen jaaboo : "Ɗin reweteeɗi majjirii men". Ɓe seeditoo e ko'e maɓɓe, wonnde ɓe laatino yedduɓe. Kono ngol seeditagol yananee ko hujja tun wonata e maɓɓe, wanaa fii si nafay ɓe.
